I answered Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is Thea Ramaswell, their Director of Yard Operations.

That comes from two places Marcus can see himself. Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged the duplicate arrivals on door 6 on the morning shift. The North team cheat sheet in the shared files also lists Thea as the main contact for Quarrendon Freight Lines.
